results.name: edge zones are 8 px at each side (inclusive); a desktop too narrow for two zones has none; NaN never matches
neighbours follow list order (non-contiguous ids); none past either end or for an unknown active workspace
arming: enter with a neighbour arms, without one does not; moving inside keeps; leaving disarms; edge → other edge re-arms
latch: after a hop the same edge never re-arms and its half-snap is suppressed; leaving releases the latch
exhaustive: every (state, side, canHop) — 'arm' only when entering a non-latched edge with a neighbour; state.side = input side
